sql: SELECT c.nome_urna, c.sigla_partido AS partido, m.nome AS municipio, m.uf, ROUND(q.patrimonio) AS patrimonio FROM vw_q2_patrimonio q JOIN candidatura c ON c.id_candidatura = q.id_candidatura JOIN municipio m ON m.cod_ibge = c.cod_ibge WHERE q.ano = 2024 AND q.cargo = 'VEREADOR' AND q.eleito ORDER BY q.patrimonio DESC LIMIT 5
